summary: Irish low-cost airline and Europe's biggest by passengers. Boarding passes are digital only, in the Ryanair app.
checkin: Without a reserved seat, free online check-in runs from 24 to 2 hours before departure. Airport check-in (until 40 minutes before) costs an airport check-in fee.
baggage: The Basic fare includes 1 small bag (40 x 30 x 20 cm) that fits under the seat. A larger cabin bag comes with Priority, and checked bags cost extra.
tips: Since November 12, 2025 boarding passes are only in the app; if you have no smartphone, check in online first and the airport prints one free.
Priority passengers at the gate 30 minutes before departure board first.
